proof_nl:
Let m = floor(nr). Since n > 1, in particular n is positive. From 0 <= r, multiplying by the positive সংখ্যা n gives 0 <= nr. Because m = floor(nr) is the greatest integer less than or equal to nr, and 0 is an integer with 0 <= nr, it follows that m >= 0.

Also, since r < 1 and n > 0, multiplying by n gives nr < n. Again by the floor property, m <= nr, so m < n.

Therefore 0 <= m < n, as required.
solver_summary: Use 0 <= r to get 0 <= nr, hence floor(nr) >= 0. Use r < 1 and n > 0 to get nr < n, and since floor(nr) <= nr, conclude floor(nr) < n.
